question: Does requiring at least two independently detected seam edges per triangle yield a locally consistent teacher-free face partition with >=0.90 mixed-face precision and >=0.70 unsafe cross-region recall?
face_partition_rule: A face is locally splittable iff at least two of its three edges satisfy the frozen seam rule. One-edge cases are not split because they are not an equivalence-consistent vertex partition.
teacher_policy: All edge scores, rule masks, 2-core pruning and seam multiplicities are frozen before teacher topology is loaded.
